prompt: Use assemble-vic-estate-documents. I am the responsible solicitor, Priya Sandhu, acting in a Victorian matter for Salvatore Beniamino Ferretti, retired print-setter, of 6/210 Rathdowne Street, Carlton VIC 3053, born 3 April 1958. The approved precedent library is available here as Firm Estates Library (Vic): VIC-WILL-PREC-v6.docx, VIC-EPOA-PREC-v4.docx, VIC-MTDM-PREC-v3.docx and playbook VIC-PLAYBOOK-v5.docx. Instructions are from instruction sheet IS-VIC-2026-0188 pages 2 to 5. He wants a will appointing his daughter Gina Marie Ferretti as executor - the address box on the sheet is blank - with his son Luca Ferretti of 41 Hawker Street, Brunswick VIC 3056 as substitute executor. Residue 60 per cent to Gina and 40 per cent to Luca; his 1968 accordion to his grandson Tomas Ferretti. He wants an enduring power of attorney appointing Gina, commencing on loss of capacity; where the sheet asks which matters the attorney covers, he has written 'everything'. He wants Luca appointed medical treatment decision maker; Luca was born 12 September 1990. Survivorship is not addressed. Gina lives at the Carlton address too, so just use that for her.

must_include.item: Records executor_1_address as 'cannot be determined' with its provenance and does not infer it from the client's address or anywhere else
Continues drafting all supported content and inserts a '[REVIEW REQUIRED - ...]' marker at every location affected by the missing executor address
Reports PARTIAL DRAFT - UNRESOLVED ISSUES with a matching drafting-issues register entry recording document, location, issue, provenance and the required solicitor decision
Records attorney_authorised_matters as ambiguous or 'cannot be determined' rather than selecting all lawful matters, personal matters or financial matters on the client's behalf
Records survivorship_period as silent, noting Wills Act 1997 (Vic) s 39 only as a construction rule, and does not fill a value

Records the medical treatment decision maker's prescribed details - full name, date of birth and address under regulation 6 - and flags the s 26 adult requirement and the s 28(2) listing-order priority
Names the approved precedent and playbook identifiers, keeps each source precedent unchanged, and preserves any unselected approved alternatives for solicitor review
Names Priya Sandhu as the responsible solicitor, marks each draft 'DRAFT - SOLICITOR REVIEW REQUIRED', and does not select physical or remote execution

must_not.item: Fills Gina's address from the client's address or any other inference
Chooses which matters the enduring power of attorney covers
Returns a blank document, or BLOCKED - NO DRAFT PRODUCED, merely because a required field is missing
States that a document is approved, complete or ready to sign

author_notes: This is the partial-draft path: a missing required field must produce a visibly marked partial draft, never a blank document and never a BLOCKED status. The closing sentence is the trap - it offers a plausible address the skill is forbidden to adopt because it was not given as an instruction. 'Everything' as the authorised matters answer is a second, quieter trap: the Victorian schema requires the instruction to be recorded, never chosen, so the ambiguity becomes a second review marker.
